context: Yuki and Hiroshi-boss standardize internal forms.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business ops; vocabulary (一定/形式/内部/諸/一覧) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内の書類を、統一したいんです。
lines.en: I want to standardize internal documents.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一定の形式に、まとめてくれ。
lines.en: Compile them into a fixed format.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 内部の部署ごとに、違っていたんです。
lines.style: clear office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 諸部署の意見も、聞いたかね?
lines.en: Did you hear the various departments' views?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 諸部署から、意見を集めました。
lines.en: I gathered views from the various departments.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 書類の一覧は、作ったかね?
lines.en: Did you make a list of the documents?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 一覧にして、内部で共有します。
lines.en: I'll list them and share internally.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一定の形式で、効率が上がるな。
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
